description: Version bumps of Tautulli stay human-reviewed pull requests: Tautulli upgrades the schema of its SQLite database on every start, with no step back down, which a fresh-install Molecule run cannot see.

packageRules.description: ghcr.io/tautulli/tautulli tags its releases `vX.Y.Z`, next to `vX.Y.Z-beta` prereleases and floating `latest`, `beta` and `nightly` tags. This keeps a bump to the release tags.
